key_highlights: Bond market 'riot' rattles Wall Street; ASX follows lower, finishing flat as miners offset oil-stock weakness (IDP plummets)
AUD 'pulverised' by US economic boom; USD strength pressures export earnings and import costs
RBA expected to hike again as inflation pressures test credibility; flash PMI sags, signalling softening domestic demand
Trump-Xi tarmac meeting looms; diesel export ban debate threatens Australian energy supply chains
Gold miners surge: Critical Resources (Suriname), Aurum ($52.5M raise), Jupiter rare earths offtake progress
Intergenerational Report 2026 flags structural fiscal gap, reinforcing tax-reform debate
Property: rising listings and falling demand push prices lower; Chinese property recovery uncertain
Jetstar industrial action escalates; Qantas confirms Sydney-New York non-stop timeline

sectors.trend: Miners rose to support ASX flat close; gold names (Critical Resources, Aurum) surged on project milestones; rare earths (Jupiter) gained on offtake progress. Oil stocks struggled amid falling crude.
sectors.implications: Gold and critical-minerals names offer relative strength in a risk-off tape. BHP.AX, RIO.AX, FMG.AX benefit from AUD weakness boosting USD-denominated revenue. Energy miners (WDS.AX, WLE.AX) face headwinds from oil softness.

sectors.trend: Bond-market volatility pressures bank NIMs; RBA hike expectations support net interest margins but credit-risk concerns linger. IDP (International Paper) plunge signals global paper/packaging stress.
sectors.implications: CBA.AX, NAB.AX, ANZ.AX, WBC.AX may see margin support from higher rates but face valuation compression if bond yields spike. Monitor RBA credibility risk.

sectors.trend: Fuel-price fears as global buffers dry up; diesel export ban debate (US) creates supply-chain risk for Australia. Energy policy debate (nuclear, cost-of-living) intensifies.
sectors.implications: WDS.AX, WLE.AX, SXG.AX face volatile crude backdrop. Domestic energy (IGL.AX, AGL.AX) may benefit from policy uncertainty and nuclear debate.

sectors.trend: Syngenis gains precision-medicine firepower; migrant doctors filling GP gaps highlight structural demand. CSL remains a defensive anchor.
sectors.implications: CSL.AX, SYG.AX, SGH.AX offer defensive positioning. Healthcare demand structurally supported by ageing population (IGR 2026).

sectors.trend: Jetstar industrial action escalates (fee waivers); Qantas confirms SFO-NYC non-stop. Consumer confidence at second-lowest level (Goldman). Retail stocks face key earnings tests.
sectors.implications: QAN.AX, JPA.AX face cost and operational risk. WES.AX, WOW.AX under pressure from weak consumer sentiment and rising fuel costs.

sectors.trend: Rising listings and falling demand drive property prices lower. Chinese property recovery uncertain. Higher RBA rates pressure valuations.
sectors.implications: REITs (GPW.AX, DGL.AX, ICOL.AX) face cap-rate expansion risk. Monitor Chinese property data for global risk sentiment.

sectors.trend: $16B Aussie tech firm in China-links dispute; Nine CEO reshuffle; AI/cybersecurity themes active globally.
sectors.implications: Media (NEG.AX, W1.AX) face structural disruption. Tech exposure via CSL digital health and ASX-listed software names.

key_themes: Bond-market volatility and 'bond market riot' driving global risk-off
AUD weakness vs USD: export revenue boost but import-cost inflation
RBA rate-hike cycle vs softening PMI and consumer confidence
Trump-Xi diplomacy and diesel export ban as energy-supply risk
Intergenerational fiscal gap and tax-reform imperative
Property market correction: supply rising, demand falling

risk_assessment.mitigation: Hedge duration risk; favour short-duration credit; monitor 10Y AUS bond yields
Overweight USD-revenue miners (BHP.AX, RIO.AX); underweight import-dependent consumer staples
Track RBA statements; position for potential 25bp hike; watch inflation print

risk_assessment.risk_factor: Diesel export ban / energy supply disruption
risk_assessment.mitigation: Monitor US legislative debate; favour domestic energy producers; hedge fuel-cost exposure
Reduce REIT exposure; favour cash-generative, low-leverage property names
Avoid JPA.AX near-term; monitor QAN.AX for spillover
Diversify away from China-exposed miners; monitor PRC data

opportunities.rationale: Gold miners surging on project milestones; AUD weakness boosts USD revenue; safe-haven demand amid bond volatility

opportunities.recommendation: Add large-cap diversified miners for AUD hedge
opportunities.rationale: AUD 'pulverised' by USD boom; BHP/RIO/FMG benefit from currency tailwind and commodity demand
Structural demand from ageing population (IGR 2026); Syngenis precision-medicine catalyst; CSL as quality anchor
Fuel-price fears and diesel-ban risk support domestic producers; nuclear debate may unlock long-term policy shift

defensive_moves.rationale: Rising listings, falling demand, higher RBA rates pressure valuations; Chinese property uncertainty adds global risk

defensive_moves.recommendation: Avoid Jetstar; monitor Qantas for spillover
defensive_moves.rationale: Escalating industrial action with fee waivers signals revenue pressure and operational disruption
Bond-market 'riot' and RBA hike path create volatility; favour short-duration or floating-rate instruments
AUD weakness raises input costs; consumer confidence at second-lowest level; fuel-price fears squeeze household budgets

market_outlook.short_term: ASX likely to remain range-bound to modestly lower over 1–3 months. Bond-market volatility, RBA hike expectations, and AUD weakness create headwinds. Miners and gold provide relative support. Consumer and REIT sectors under pressure. Jetstar industrial action adds idiosyncratic risk. Watch jobs data and RBA commentary for directional catalyst.
market_outlook.long_term: 6–12 month outlook cautiously constructive for quality earnings (miners, healthcare, banks) but constrained by fiscal concerns (IGR 2026), property correction, and global growth uncertainty. Trump-Xi outcome and diesel-ban resolution are key swing factors. Nuclear energy policy shift could create a multi-year theme for domestic energy. Structural demand in healthcare and critical minerals supports long-term positioning.

Chinese property data and recovery trajectory

Chinese property sales and PMI data
Diesel export ban legislative progress (US Congress)
